name: Seed My Wife
source: Somewhere in Southern Europe, an unremarkable couple faces a heartbreaking reality— they cannot conceive a child due to the husband's infertility. Afraid of scorn and ridicule, they choose to keep their struggle private. Instead of seeking medical intervention, they turn to the Father-in-law for a more… direct solution.
translation: 在南欧的某个地方，一对不起眼的夫妇面临着令人心碎的现实——由于丈夫不孕，他们无法怀孕。由于害怕轻蔑和嘲笑，他们选择将自己的斗争保密。他们没有寻求医疗干预，而是向岳父寻求更……直接的解决方案。
